Messages.Author: Lasse Winther Wehner
Messages.Body:
Just to double check:

Can a Vampire who has Black Metamorphosis on him play additional strike
cards. I do not think so, but I'd like to get it confirmed.

Lasse

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
"Lasse Winther Wehner" <l...@get2net.dk> writes:

> Can a Vampire who has Black Metamorphosis on him play additional strike
> cards. I do not think so, but I'd like to get it confirmed.

No, unless the additional strikes over-rule the standard "1 source per
round" requirement, since BM is NOT optional.

Messages.Author: Mikael Hallin
Messages.Body:
>No, unless the additional strikes over-rule the
>standard "1 source per
>round" requirement, since BM is NOT optional.

Actually black metamorphosis _is_ optional...

Black Metamorphosis: Action, Obtenebration, 2 blood
Put this card on the acting vampire. A vampire may
have only one Black Metamorphosis. This vampire gets
one optional additional strike per round. (S) As
above, and this vampire gets an optional press once
each combat.

however you're not allowed to use it's additional
strike _and_ another source of additional strikes
unless the other card overrules that.

You can use it with quickness or on jacko(they both
overrule it), the latter being a very nice combo :)
